name: presidio-pii
description: Local reversible PII redaction for DeepSeek Harness: redacts Chinese PII before prompts leave the harness, restores placeholders after the LLM responds.

on_before_llm.description: Redact PII in the outgoing prompt; stores mappings under a per-conversation session_id.

on_after_llm.description: Restore ⟦PII:TYPE:SEQ⟧ placeholders in the LLM response back to original PII.
